task: ae.rangecoder: range coder, Fenwick model, bit models and 5-engine context-model compressor
reasoning_summary: Built an LZMA-style range coder with both frequency and adaptive-bit coding, a Fenwick adaptive model and a CRC-sealed compressor with five engines. Tests were written first: Fenwick vs naive oracle, carry-count measurement, empirical-entropy bounds, flip/truncate loops. Two expectation errors (Fenwick boundary arithmetic, bit-model saturation/adaptation tax) were fixed in tests; code was unchanged. Hand mutation found three test gaps (ratio guard, leading byte, context cap) that were closed.
